VI.description: DEMONSTRATION MODEL - the replaceable sensor source. One simulation step of length dt. SOC: ideal C-rate integration (dSOC = C x 100 x dt x SpeedFactor / 3600) clamped 0..100. Voltage and current: first-order approach to the setpoints (discharge current negative). Temperature: current-squared heating with first-order cooling to ambient. OUTPUT INTERLOCK: only CHARGING enables the simulated supply and only DISCHARGING the simulated load; every other state forces both OFF and current to 0. Not an electrochemical battery model. A later hardware phase replaces this VI.

Node.text: float64 kV, kI, dSoc, vT, iT, p, l, iN; kV = min(dt / max(tauV, 0.001), 1); kI = min(dt / max(tauI, 0.001), 1); dSoc = crate * 100 * dt * spd / 3600; p = 0; l = 0; if (st == 2) { p = 1; vT = vset; iT = iset; } else if (st == 3) { l = 1; vT = vset; iT = -iset; dSoc = -dSoc; } else { vT = vrest; iT = 0; dSoc = 0; } socO = min(max(soc + dSoc, 0), 100); vO = v + (vT - v) * kV; if (p + l == 0) iN = 0; else iN = i + (iT - i) * kI; iO = iN; tO = t + dt * (heatK * iN * iN - (t - tamb) / max(tauT, 0.001)); rtO = rt + dt; if (p + l > 0) elO = el + dt; else elO = el; psO = p; ldO = l;
